description: First collection (2026-11-04) of the two required primary YouTube queries for compound_thcnm, collected as two independent runs: THCNM リキッド (thcnm-liquid-ja) and THA リキッド (tha-liquid-ja). THA is the alias / commercial name of THCNM, not a second substance, so the two runs measure two query strings and their counts are never merged. One query per run, no dateFilter, current Actor input names. Raw stays git_untracked; the repository keeps this declaration, the catalog entries and the run metadata.

runs.purpose: First collection run for the declared primary query `THCNM リキッド` (query registry canonical text) of compound_thcnm, added to the compound set on 2026-11-04. One query per run, no dateFilter, current Actor input names. It covers only its own query_id; it is not a substitute for `tha-liquid-ja`, and the study counts its records separately from that run. The run finished with status SUCCEEDED.

collection_request.actor_input_basis: Submitted verbatim through netloom apify run. The payload's input column is ['THCNM リキッド'] for all 30 records and its type column is ['video'] for all 30, which is consistent with but not proof of the submitted input values.
collection_request.date_filter_basis: No dateFilter was supplied to the actor, so the request carried neither an absolute nor a rolling publish-date restriction. 'all' is the declaration vocabulary for that unbounded request (src/collection/adapters/youtube/apify_csv.py DATE_FILTERS); the actor has no 'all' enum value.

temporal.boundary_semantics: Observed video publish-date range in the payload, normalized to a half-open UTC day interval; not the API condition and not a request window.
limitations: The request had no dateFilter and therefore no absolute publish-date window; the search was unbounded as far as the actor input states.
window.start is the earliest observed video publish date at 00:00:00Z and window.end_exclusive is one day after the latest observed publish date; both are derived from the returned items only.

The run finished with status SUCCEEDED and returned 30 records against maxResults 500. The payload does not establish that every matching video existed or was returned; it is a search-result sample, not a census.
The run is not country-limited by an API geo filter. The Japanese product term リキッド approximates a Japanese-market restriction through query language; this is not a geographic guarantee.

The records measure content matching the query string only. compound_thcnm's chemical identity is unconfirmed (THA is an alias / commercial name), so a match is not evidence that a verified substance appeared (ISS-20261104-TAX-028).

timestamps.basis: Apify actor run status object read through netloom apify run-status on 2026-11-04; startedAt and finishedAt are the run's own UTC timestamps.

environment.actor_build_basis: buildNumber and buildId of the actor run status object (netloom apify run-status, 2026-11-04).
environment.handover_note: source is this collection session's export directory, where netloom apify dataset wrote the actor's dataset export. The durable copy is the adopted run directory data/raw/youtube/<run-id>/<file> (git_untracked per raw-data-policy), and payload_sha256/payload_bytes are the values verified for it at adoption.
environment.payload_shape: The actor's dataset export: a JSON array of flat records with 33 keys (id, date, input, type, title, channelId, viewCount, ...). It carries no 'kind' discriminator, so 'youtube-search-result-list-v1' is this study's schema label for this actor's dataset JSON, not a nested youtube#searchResult shape.

observed_range.derivation: min/max of the payload's date column, converted to UTC; window.start/end_exclusive are the half-open day normalization of these bounds. Derived observation only.

deduplication.note: Checked within this run only. No de-duplication was applied to the raw payload; downstream analysis performs reproducible deduplication. Records are not summed across runs or queries.

scope.primary_coverage: one of two required primary queries for compound_thcnm
